powers.name: Pyrotechnics

params.text: shoots a harmless burst of colorful light

powers.text: 1 charge: it shoots a harmless burst of colorful light. (No other effect in the game.)

summary: 7 charges: it shoots a harmless burst of colorful light.
text: Spend 1 of its 7 charges as a Magic action while holding it and the wand lets off a harmless spray of multicoloured light. It recovers 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn; spending the final charge means rolling 1d20, and a 1 reduces it to dust. (Purely flavour; it does nothing else in the game.)
